decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan, GTD391HPA - 01, GTD391HPA - 02 and GTD391HPA - 03 received on 21/07/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those listed in drawing number GTD391HPA - 02 received on 21/07/2014.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side and rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the outbuilding without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 22 Byron Avenue, TW4 6LX.
description: Erection of rear outbuilding for use as storage
